label: copy phase: input b/k while outputting k, later in the copy
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, only when the fed-back input token is b (72% of mass) or k (28%), and only on non-first occurrences of that token. Strongly tied to the output being k (89% of mass): the strongest activations are input b -> output k (original contains the bigram b k), e.g. o n b k k <DEL> o n [b] [k]. Weaker activations occur for input k -> output k (bigram k k) and for b/k inputs with other outputs (b->b, k->b, b->other). Essentially silent for recall_idx 0-1 and weak at recall_idx 2; the rate peaks around recall_idx 3-5. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases or on any other input token. Predicate in{b,k} & out=k & recall_idx>=3 gets dev F1 0.72 / mass recall 0.84; the remaining false positives are mostly k->k steps where it stays off, and the misses are low-magnitude b steps with non-k outputs.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=b (+7.67), phase=2 & in_tok=k (+5.96), next_out=k (+4.69), phase=2 & out_tok=k (+4.52), out_tok=k (+4.04), in_tok=b (+4.03). Lower it: prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.89), recall_idx=1 (-3.89), orig_idx=-1 (-2.03), in_first=0 (-1.75).
